    // Whether the text is an optional sign and one or more decimal digits whose value fits
    // Integer under the profile (64-bit under cpu64, 32-bit under cpu64i32 and gpu32).
    // "-0", "+7" and "007" are integers. "", "+", "1.0", "1e3", " 1" and a value past the
    // range are not: overflow is reported, never wrapped. Pairs with IntegerFromText in
    // ParseInteger (text.library.plato). Witness: IsIntegerText("-12") and not
    // IsIntegerText("99999999999999999999").
    IsIntegerText(s: String): Boolean;
